rules.name: SEBI Block Deal Reporting
rules.description: Block deals with notional value above ₹10,000,000 (1 Crore) must be reported to the exchange immediately.

rules.name: Standard Exchange Trading Hours
rules.description: Trades executed outside standard trading hours (09:00–17:00 IST) require special clearing pre-approval.

rules.name: SEBI Contract Lot Size Limit
rules.description: Derivative trades with contract size values below ₹500,000 require consolidation to prevent order fragmentation.

rules.name: KYC Completeness Audit
rules.description: All customer account transactions must have verified customer_id (trader_id), channel (venue), and counterparty populated.

rules.name: CCIL Unique Trade Identifier
rules.description: Each transaction must have a unique trade_id to prevent duplicate submissions to Clearing Corporation of India.

rules.name: RBI Large Exposure Limit
rules.description: A single counterparty exposure must not exceed 25% of the total daily desk capital/volume.

rules.name: Algorithmic Order-to-Trade Ratio (OTR)
rules.description: High cancel rate (>10% volume) triggers exchange algotrading penalties.

rules.name: Price Reasonableness Check
rules.description: Trade price must not deviate by more than 3 standard deviations from the asset's mean trading price.

rules.name: Volume Manipulation Check
rules.description: Trade quantities deviating by more than 3 standard deviations trigger front-running surveillance warnings.

rules.name: SEBI T+1 Settlement Age Limit
rules.description: Equity/Derivative trades remaining pending for more than 1 business day breach the mandatory T+1 cycle.
